title: Mid-cycle reprioritization & buffer guardrails
creator: Diego Martinez
description: Problem: Mid-cycle scope shifts and emergent incidents frequently force ad-hoc staff reassignments and untracked scope cuts, causing uneven delivery and missed SLAs. Goal: Define a lightweight, repeatable reprioritization workflow and buffer guardrails that PMs, Eng leads, and Design can run during a cycle without destabilizing critical work. Deliverables: 1) Decision checklist and escalation matrix, 2) Buffer accounting model (staff-hours and feature buffer), 3) Triage cadence (weekly fast sync + mid-cycle review), 4) Template for recorded decisions and rollback criteria, 5) Sample run with runtime and console teams. Acceptance criteria: - Playbook reviewed and signed off by Eng leads for runtime, infra, and console. - Two pilot cycles use the checklist and report metrics. - No regressions to priority P0 items in pilots.
